versions.changelog:
Initial release of the supplier-management-plan skill.

- Enables supplier quality managers to generate comprehensive supplier management plans using a standard nine-part framework.
- Covers classification, admission, performance evaluation, auditing, change management, agreements, development support, and risk response.
- Outputs both plain text (.txt) and Markdown (.md) documents for easy archival and circulation.
- Guides users interactively to collect inputs, confirm outlines, and export structured plans.
- Ensures clarity by marking any company-specific thresholds as "to be supplemented by the enterprise."
